success.description: As above, and your shield hits the target for 4 + Toughness damage {Dc}.

conservative.requirements: GET DEFENCE Shield equipped; engaged with target. You cannot use the Block action while this action is recharging. If not recharging when you successfully use this card, you may add 2 recharge tokens to Block to add 2 recharge tokens to this card. Effect: By pressing your shield against the target’s body, you bind his limbs and control his movements. While this action is recharging, your target adds {Dc} to attack rolls that target him and adds 10 to attacks that target you. If the target's turn immediately ends and this action recharges completely.
